confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from one aggregated search, which returned Numbeo-based figures (June 2026, via Expatica): cappuccino about £3.65, 0.5L draught beer about £6.07, inexpensive meal about £15, and three-course meal for two about £71. I converted from GBP to USD at roughly 1.33 USD per GBP, which is my own assumption and was not searched. No Manchester cocktail or wine-by-the-glass price was found. Cocktail is estimated at about 1.8x the beer price and wine glass at about 1.25x, based on typical UK pub and bar relationships. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge, with no accommodation searches or live listings checked. They are the least certain anchors, and prices vary widely with events and football weekends. The FX rate is the 4pm 18 Nov 2026 RBA figure, which the Exchange Rates Overview, RBA homepage and RSS feed all showed. One RBA statistics page showed 0.6677 for 19 Nov, but it looked inconsistent and possibly preliminary, so I did not use it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Manchester is a large UK regional city with prices below London. The estimates rest on UK city-level price indexes, with accommodation modelled on other major UK regional cities such as Birmingham and Leeds.
